notes: Many set names, set bonuses, locations, and shop/shrine names on this page do not match official Tears of the Kingdom armor; they are translated faithfully and descriptively as written, not corrected to official game data. Where a set matches an official set, the official English name is used (e.g. Flamebreaker, Rubber, Snowquill, Desert Voe, Froggy, Climbing, Glide, Stealth, Radiant, Barbarian, Dark, Evil Spirit, Phantom, Royal Guard, Hylian, Soldier's, Zora, Yiga, Ember, Zonaite).

Uncertain/descriptive names: 黑暗套装=Shadow Set, 织梦之勇者套装=Hero of Awakening Set, 初始之勇者套装=Classic Hero Set, 精灵套装=Fairy Set, 采矿套装=Miner Set, 雷光套装=Lightning Set, 利特套装=Rito Set, 神兽兵装 (Ruta/Medoh/Rudania/Naboris pieces)=Divine Beast Armor pieces, 异次元恶灵套装=Otherworldly Evil Spirit Set, 汀空套装=Tingkong Set (transliterated; the Chinese name is unclear), 依盖队套装=Yiga Set.
Fairy names: 忒拉=Tera, 弥佳=Mija are official-style transliterations; 西莎 and 可秋拉 do not match official Great Fairy names and are transliterated as Xisha and Keqiula.
Place/shop/shrine names that do not match official names (e.g. 骨狂人之火, 奥鲁克神庙, 利达尔山脉, 罗吉鲁神庙, 纳贝坎努神庙, 阿库拉遗迹, 科加遗迹) are transliterated descriptively.

The upgrade table body on this page is rendered by JavaScript from script data; per the spec's 'exclude script content' rule, only the static table header and footnote are included — the per-set material rows are not in the static HTML.
Repair pass 2026-11-02: appended missing pairs only; existing pairs/titles untouched.
Clothes upgrade-data keys are copied verbatim from the source script, including literal \n separators between material lines; values mirror the same structure.
左纳乌能源结晶 rendered as Crystallized Charge (the battery-upgrade currency); 左纳乌能源 as Zonaite Charge and 大容量左纳乌能源 as Large Zonaite Charge.
精力蜂的蜂蜜 rendered as Courser Bee Honey (matches the Wild Set upgrade slot: honey + dragon claw).
静谧凤蝶 has no confirmed official English item name; rendered descriptively as Tranquil Butterfly.
冷气果 rendered as Ice Fruit (the game's cold fruit); the site's name has no confirmed official mapping.
火/冰/电蝙蝠的角 and 火/冰/雷龙头 are the site's own wording with no confirmed official item equivalent; rendered literally (e.g. Fire Keese Horn, Fire Dragon's Head).
暗萤火虫 and 暗之萤火虫 both rendered as Deep Firefly (two site spellings for the same critter).

Site set names that are descriptive rather than official are translated descriptively: 汀空套装（左纳尼乌姆） as Depths Set (Zonaite), 防火套装（鼓隆） as Fireproof Set (Goron), 防热套装（格鲁德） as Heat-Resistant Set (Gerudo), 防雪套装（利特） as Snowproof Set (Rito).
Captain Construct horns: site shorthand （中）/（上）/（极） mapped to official II/III/IV (plain = I), per Zelda Wiki translations (中等/上等/特等).
Wild Set rows keep the site's generic 龙 (Dragon) wording rather than substituting Farosh/Dinraal/Naydra.

🔥 火焰免疫 套装加成：急速
🔥 Fire Immunity · Set bonus: Speed Boost
穿戴后可在火山、熔岩地区自由活动，不受灼热伤害。三件齐穿解锁急速套装加成，移动速度大幅提升。前往鼓隆城及格鲁德火山必备。

After wearing it, you can move freely in volcanic and lava areas without taking scorching damage. Wearing all three pieces unlocks the Speed Boost set bonus, greatly increasing movement speed. Essential for heading to Goron City and the Gerudo volcano.
获取：前往鼓隆城（骨狂人之火）杂货店购买，需先完成进城任务。三件合计约 2400 卢比。
How to get: buy at the general store in Goron City (Bone Madman's Fire); you must first complete the quest to enter the city. All three pieces cost about 2,400 Rupees in total.
获取：前往鼓隆城（骨狂人之火）杂货店购买，需先完成进城任务。
How to get: buy at the general store in Goron City (Bone Madman's Fire); you must first complete the quest to enter the city.
All three pieces cost about 2,400 Rupees in total.
⚡ 雷击免疫 套装加成：静电
⚡ Lightning Immunity · Set bonus: Static Electricity
穿戴后免疫雷击伤害，不会被闪电击落武器。三件齐穿解锁静电加成，攻击可传导雷电。雷电神庙及雷击平原探索必备。

After wearing it, you are immune to lightning damage and lightning won't knock weapons out of your hands. Wearing all three pieces unlocks the Static Electricity bonus, letting attacks conduct lightning. Essential for exploring lightning shrines and lightning plains.
获取：完成三座「奥鲁克神庙」（雷型神庙）任务。头部：雷电山脉区域神庙；上身：法罗尼高原神庙；腿部：雷击平原神庙。

How to get: complete the three 'Oruk Shrine' (lightning-type shrine) quests. Head: a shrine in the lightning mountain region; torso: a shrine in the Faron Highlands; legs: a shrine in the lightning plains.
❄ 耐寒强化 套装加成：雪地急速
❄ Enhanced Cold Resistance · Set bonus: Snow Speed Boost
强力耐寒套装，穿戴后可在极寒地区活动无需进食热食。三件齐穿解锁雪地急速，在雪地中移动速度大幅加快。

A powerful cold-resistant set; after wearing it, you can be active in extremely cold regions without eating hot food. Wearing all three pieces unlocks Snow Speed Boost, greatly increasing movement speed in snow.
获取：利达尔山脉山顶商店购买，需在极寒环境下抵达（建议先有耐寒食物）。三件合计约 2100 卢比。

How to get: buy at the mountaintop shop in the Lidar Mountains, which must be reached in an extremely cold environment (cold-resistant food is recommended first). All three pieces cost about 2,100 Rupees in total.
获取：利达尔山脉山顶商店购买，需在极寒环境下抵达（建议先有耐寒食物）。
How to get: buy at the mountaintop shop in the Lidar Mountains, which must be reached in an extremely cold environment (cold-resistant food is recommended first).
All three pieces cost about 2,100 Rupees in total.
☀ 耐热强化 套装加成：沙地急速
☀ Enhanced Heat Resistance · Set bonus: Sand Speed Boost
保护身体免受灼热沙漠气候影响，可在杰鲁多沙漠白天自由行动。三件齐穿在沙地中移动速度提升。
Protects the body from the scorching desert climate, letting you move freely in the Gerudo Desert during the day. Wearing all three pieces increases movement speed on sand.
获取：杰鲁多城服装店购买，需以女性身份（穿着女装）入城。三件合计约 1800 卢比。
How to get: buy at the clothing store in Gerudo Town; you must enter the town presenting as a woman (wearing women's clothing). All three pieces cost about 1,800 Rupees in total.
获取：杰鲁多城服装店购买，需以女性身份（穿着女装）入城。
How to get: buy at the clothing store in Gerudo Town; you must enter the town presenting as a woman (wearing women's clothing).
All three pieces cost about 1,800 Rupees in total.
🌧 雨天不滑 套装加成：雨天急速
🌧 No Slipping in Rain · Set bonus: Rain Speed Boost
模仿青蛙皮肤的套装，穿戴后在雨天攀爬不会滑落，与普通套装下雨效果完全相反。三件齐穿雨天移动极速。

A set modeled on frog skin; after wearing it, climbing in the rain won't make you slip, the complete opposite of ordinary sets' rainy effect. Wearing all three pieces makes movement extremely fast in rain.
获取：完成支线「卡卡利科村青蛙任务」系列，找到并帮助三只青蛙 NPC 后各获得一件。
How to get: complete the 'Kakariko Village Frog Quests' side quest series; after finding and helping three frog NPCs, you receive one piece from each.
🧗 攀爬速度↑ 套装加成：攀爬急速
🧗 Climbing Speed ↑ · Set bonus: Climbing Speed Boost
专为攀爬设计的轻量化套装，每件都能提升攀爬速度。三件齐穿后攀爬速度接近疾跑，是探索高地和天空岛的最佳搭档。

A lightweight set designed for climbing; each piece increases climbing speed. With all three pieces worn, climbing speed is close to sprinting, making it the best partner for exploring highlands and Sky Islands.
获取：三件分别藏于特定神庙宝箱中。头部：罗吉鲁神庙；上身：纳贝坎努神庙；腿部：特定天空岛神庙。
How to get: the three pieces are hidden in specific shrine treasure chests. Head: Luojilu Shrine; torso: Nabeikanu Shrine; legs: a specific Sky Island shrine.
🪂 滑翔速度↑ 套装加成：空中跳跃
🪂 Gliding Speed ↑ · Set bonus: Midair Jump
专为滑翔伞使用者设计，穿戴后滑翔速度加快，方向控制更灵活。三件齐穿可在滑翔中额外跳跃一次，探索天空岛极为实用。

Designed for paraglider users; after wearing it, gliding speed increases and directional control becomes more flexible. With all three pieces worn, you can jump once more mid-glide, which is extremely useful for exploring Sky Islands.
获取：完成天空岛挑战（四个地区天空岛各一件）：头部在利特天空岛；上身在卓拉天空岛；腿部在鼓隆天空岛。
How to get: complete the Sky Island challenges (one piece per Sky Island across four regions): head on the Rito Sky Island; torso on the Zora Sky Island; legs on the Goron Sky Island.
🌙 降低噪音 套装加成：极致潜行
🌙 Reduced Noise · Set bonus: Ultimate Stealth
谢卡族传统潜行服，穿戴后移动声音极小，不易被敌人察觉。三件齐穿后几乎完全隐身（不含视觉）。是偷袭和绕过敌人的首选套装。

A traditional Sheikah stealth outfit; after wearing it, movement sounds are minimal and enemies are less likely to notice you. With all three pieces worn, you are almost completely hidden (excluding visual detection). It is the first-choice set for ambushes and slipping past enemies.
获取：卡卡利科村夜间商店（夜晚才开门）购买。三件合计约 1500 卢比，需在夜晚前往村子的服装店。
How to get: buy at the Kakariko Village night shop (only open at night). All three pieces cost about 1,500 Rupees in total; you must visit the village clothing store at night.
✨ 夜间发光 套装加成：暗中加速
✨ Glows at Night · Set bonus: Speed Boost in Darkness
夜晚会散发柔和光芒的神秘套装，在地底黑暗区域照亮周围，减少用火把的需求。三件齐穿夜间移动速度加快。
A mysterious set that gives off a soft glow at night, lighting up the surroundings in the dark Depths and reducing the need for torches. With all three pieces worn, movement speed increases at night.
获取：三件分别位于地底世界的特定宝箱中，对应地表三个区域的地底版本宝箱。
How to get: the three pieces are located in specific treasure chests in the Depths, corresponding to the Depths versions of chests in three surface regions.
⚔ 攻击力↑ 套装加成：破防双倍
⚔ Attack Power ↑ · Set bonus: Double Defense Break
野蛮骑士穿戴的战斗套装，每件提升攻击力，三件齐穿后攻击伤害翻倍。是打莱乃尔、BOSS 战的核心战斗套装，后期必备。

A combat set worn by barbarian knights; each piece increases attack power, and with all three pieces worn, attack damage doubles. It is the core combat set for fighting Lynels and bosses, and essential in the late game.
获取：三件分别位于三处骷髅遗迹宝箱：头部在阿库拉遗迹；上身在科加遗迹；腿部在克洛格森林附近遗迹宝箱。
How to get: the three pieces are located in three skeletal ruin treasure chests: head at the Akula Ruins; torso at the Kega Ruins; legs in a ruin treasure chest near Korok Forest.
🖤 暗夜攻击↑ 套装加成：幽影结界
🖤 Night Attack ↑ · Set bonus: Shadow Barrier
夜晚攻击力明显提升的战斗套装，外观暗色系，三件齐穿后夜间或黑暗地区可为自身增加幽影结界减少受击伤害。

A combat set whose attack power clearly increases at night, with a dark appearance; with all three pieces worn, at night or in dark areas it adds a shadow barrier to yourself that reduces damage taken.
获取：三件均来自地底世界深层宝箱，分布在不同地底区域，需点亮破魔树根扩大地图后探索。
How to get: all three pieces come from deep Depths treasure chests, spread across different Depths regions; you must light Lightroots to expand the map before exploring.
🌑 暗影攻击 套装加成：影分身
🌑 Shadow Attack · Set bonus: Shadow Clone
与暗黑套装外观相似但效果不同，穿戴后会出现「暗影链接」效果，三件齐穿偶尔触发影分身协助攻击。是最稀有的套装之一。

Similar in appearance to the Dark Set but with different effects; after wearing it, a 'Shadow Link' effect appears, and with all three pieces worn, a shadow clone is occasionally triggered to assist in attacks. It is one of the rarest sets.
获取：完成隐藏支线「黑暗林克」系列（三个地区各一任务），击败暗影林克后获得对应部位套装。
How to get: complete the hidden 'Dark Link' side quest series (one quest in each of three regions); after defeating Shadow Link, you receive the corresponding set piece.
💥 重击强化 套装加成：震地冲击
💥 Heavy Attack Enhancement · Set bonus: Ground-Shaking Impact
充满古代力量的鬼神战甲，穿戴后蓄力攻击（重击）伤害提升，破盾效果增强。三件齐穿蓄力攻击触发地震冲击波，对多敌群战极有效。

Fierce deity armor full of ancient power; after wearing it, charged attacks (heavy attacks) deal more damage and shield-breaking is enhanced. With all three pieces worn, charged attacks trigger an earthquake shockwave, extremely effective against groups of enemies.
获取：依序完成「古代战场」系列支线任务，三件分别作为三个阶段的任务奖励。
How to get: complete the 'Ancient Battlefield' side quest series in order; the three pieces are awarded as rewards for the three stages.
👻 幻影移动 套装加成：无声刺杀
👻 Phantom Movement · Set bonus: Silent Assassination
外观宛如幽灵的神秘套装，穿戴后移动轨迹对敌人更难追踪，潜行偷袭伤害提升。三件齐穿后偷袭必定一击必杀普通敌人。

A mysterious set that looks like a ghost; after wearing it, your movement trail is harder for enemies to track, and stealth ambush damage increases. With all three pieces worn, ambushes are guaranteed to kill ordinary enemies in one hit.
获取：三件分别藏于海拉鲁大地三处隐秘神庙宝箱（不在主流神庙路线上），需解开特殊谜题才能进入。
How to get: the three pieces are hidden in three secret shrine treasure chests across Hyrule (not on the mainstream shrine routes), which require solving special puzzles to enter.
🛡 防御力最高 套装加成：盾反强化
🛡 Highest Defense · Set bonus: Shield Parry Enhancement
谢卡族古代技术铸造的终极防具，未强化时防御力已为全游戏最高。三件齐穿后盾反（完美格挡）造成更高反伤。

The ultimate armor forged with ancient Sheikah technology; even unenhanced, its defense is already the highest in the game. With all three pieces worn, shield parries (perfect guards) deal higher counter damage.
获取：三件均在海拉鲁城堡深处宝箱（需深入城堡内部）。头部在城堡西翼；上身在城堡地下；腿部在城堡塔顶。

How to get: all three pieces are in treasure chests deep inside Hyrule Castle (you must go deep into the castle interior). Head in the castle's west wing; torso in the castle basement; legs at the top of the castle tower.
勇者套装：来自历代塞尔达传说作品的经典服装，多数需通过 amiibo 扫描获得，部分可在游戏内隐藏宝箱取得。这些套装提供独特的战斗加成或特殊效果。

Hero Sets: classic outfits from past Legend of Zelda titles, mostly obtained by scanning amiibo, with some available from hidden treasure chests in-game. These sets provide unique combat bonuses or special effects.
勇者套装：来自历代塞尔达传说作品的经典服装，多数需通过 amiibo 扫描获得，部分可在游戏内隐藏宝箱取得。
Hero Sets: classic outfits from past Legend of Zelda titles, mostly obtained by scanning amiibo, with some available from hidden treasure chests in-game.
这些套装提供独特的战斗加成或特殊效果。
These sets provide unique combat bonuses or special effects.
✨ 来自《旷野之息》 ⚔ 攀爬攻击↑
✨ From Breath of the Wild · ⚔ Climbing Attack ↑
《旷野之息》林克的经典蓝色冒险服。穿戴后攀爬途中发动的攻击伤害提升，跳跃斩击强化。是探索高低起伏地形时的优选。

Link's classic blue adventuring outfit from Breath of the Wild. After wearing it, attacks launched while climbing deal more damage, and jump slashes are enhanced. It is the preferred choice when exploring uneven terrain.
获取：扫描《旷野之息》林克 amiibo 随机获得，或在游戏内特定天空岛神庙宝箱（需特殊条件解锁）。
How to get: randomly obtained by scanning the Breath of the Wild Link amiibo, or from a specific Sky Island shrine treasure chest in-game (requires special conditions to unlock).
✨ 来自《时之笛》 ⚔ 骑马攻击↑
✨ From Ocarina of Time · ⚔ Mounted Attack ↑
《时之笛》时代勇者的深色铠甲，穿戴后骑乘坐骑时攻击力提升，马背上挥剑范围更广。适合骑马决斗场景。

The dark armor of the hero from the Ocarina of Time era; after wearing it, attack power increases while riding a mount, and sword swings from horseback cover a wider range. Suits mounted duel scenarios.
获取：扫描《时之笛》林克 amiibo 随机获得，三件分别通过不同扫描获取。
How to get: randomly obtained by scanning the Ocarina of Time Link amiibo; the three pieces are obtained through separate scans.
✨ 来自《风之律动》 🌊 海上速度↑
✨ From The Wind Waker · 🌊 Sea Speed ↑
《风之律动》海洋冒险版林克的绿色水手装，穿戴后在水面和海洋地形移动速度提升，乘船速度加快。
Link's green sailor outfit from the seafaring adventure of The Wind Waker; after wearing it, movement speed increases on water and ocean terrain, and sailing speed increases.
获取：扫描《风之律动》林克 amiibo 随机获得。
How to get: randomly obtained by scanning The Wind Waker Link amiibo.
✨ 来自《黄昏公主》 ⚔ 受伤反伤
✨ From Twilight Princess · ⚔ Damage Reflection on Injury
《黄昏公主》骑士林克的深蓝铠甲，穿戴后受到伤害时有概率触发反伤效果，将伤害反弹给攻击者。
The deep-blue armor of knight Link from Twilight Princess; after wearing it, taking damage has a chance to trigger a damage-reflection effect, bouncing damage back to the attacker.
获取：扫描《黄昏公主》林克 amiibo 随机获得。
How to get: randomly obtained by scanning the Twilight Princess Link amiibo.
✨ 来自《御天之剑》 ☁ 天空岛加速
✨ From Skyward Sword · ☁ Sky Island Speed Boost
《御天之剑》飞行冒险版林克服装，穿戴后在天空岛地形的各种动作速度提升，如同原作中驾驭凌风鸟般轻盈。
Link's outfit from the flying adventure of Skyward Sword; after wearing it, all kinds of movement speeds increase on Sky Island terrain, as light as riding a Loftwing in the original game.
获取：扫描《御天之剑》林克 amiibo 随机获得。
How to get: randomly obtained by scanning the Skyward Sword Link amiibo.
✨ 来自《梦见岛》 ⚔ 盾反强化
✨ From Link's Awakening · ⚔ Shield Parry Enhancement
《梦见岛》像素风格林克的经典绿色服装（高清版），穿戴后盾反（完美格挡）的判定时间略微延长，更容易触发。

Link's classic green outfit in pixel style from Link's Awakening (HD version); after wearing it, the timing window for shield parries (perfect guards) is slightly extended, making them easier to trigger.
获取：扫描《梦见岛》林克 amiibo 随机获得。
How to get: randomly obtained by scanning the Link's Awakening Link amiibo.
✨ 经典绿色服装 🛡 均衡防御
塞尔达系列标志性的绿色精灵服，整体属性均衡，穿戴时具有回忆历代勇者的特殊加成光环，对魔法类敌人伤害略微提升。

The iconic green tunic of the Zelda series, with balanced overall stats; when worn, it carries a special bonus aura recalling heroes of past eras, and damage against magic-type enemies is slightly increased.
获取：扫描王国之泪版林克 amiibo 获得，或在主线后期特定区域的隐藏宝箱中找到。
How to get: obtained by scanning the Tears of the Kingdom Link amiibo, or found in a hidden treasure chest in a specific region late in the main story.

🛒 商店购买 🛡 基础防御
海拉鲁王国的平民服装，外观典雅，防御均衡。没有特殊加成效果，但作为城镇内穿着或早期防具是不错的选择。
The common clothing of the Kingdom of Hyrule, elegant in appearance with balanced defense. It has no special bonus effects, but it is a good choice for wearing around towns or as early-game armor.
获取：海拉鲁城镇服装店购买，三件合计约 600 卢比，游戏开始不久即可购得。
How to get: buy at a Hyrule town clothing store; all three pieces cost about 600 Rupees in total, and can be bought not long after the game starts.
🛡 士兵防御 套装加成：无
海拉鲁王国士兵的标准战甲，防御力比海利亚套装更高，外观威武。适合中早期作为主战防具使用。
The standard armor of Hyrule Kingdom soldiers, with higher defense than the Hylian Set and an imposing appearance. Suitable as main combat armor in the early-to-mid game.
获取：海拉鲁城镇士兵装备铺购买，或在城堡周边击败士兵偶尔掉落（掉落率低）。
How to get: buy at a Hyrule town soldier equipment shop, or occasionally dropped by soldiers defeated around the castle (low drop rate).
🌿 大妖精庇护 套装加成：强化加成↑
🌿 Great Fairy Blessing · Set bonus: Enhancement Bonus ↑
受大妖精祝福的精灵服，穿戴后在大妖精泉强化其他套装时所需素材数量减少。三件齐穿效果叠加，是高效强化套装的辅助搭配。

Fairy clothing blessed by the Great Fairies; after wearing it, fewer materials are needed when enhancing other sets at Great Fairy Fountains. With all three pieces worn, the effect stacks, making it a supporting combination for efficiently enhancing sets.
获取：激活游戏内四处大妖精泉后，完成大妖精系列支线任务，分别获得三件套装部位。
How to get: after activating the four Great Fairy Fountains in-game, complete the Great Fairy side quest series to receive the three set pieces.
套装加成：矿石双倍 🛒 任务奖励
Set bonus: Double Ore · 🛒 Quest Reward
鼓隆族矿工专用套装，穿戴后敲击矿石获得的素材数量提升。三件齐穿后矿物掉落双倍，是刷材料强化套装的最佳帮手。

A set made for Goron miners; after wearing it, the amount of materials obtained from striking ore increases. With all three pieces worn, mineral drops double, making it the best helper for farming materials to enhance sets.
获取：完成鼓隆城「矿工的心愿」系列支线任务（共三个），每个任务奖励一件套装部位。
How to get: complete the 'Miner's Wish' side quest series in Goron City (three quests in total); each quest rewards one set piece.
💎 古代力量 套装加成：余料加速
💎 Ancient Power · Set bonus: Fuse Speed Boost
融合佐纳依古代技术的神秘套装，穿戴后使用余料建造（融合、建造）的速度加快。三件齐穿后建造动作几乎瞬间完成。
A mysterious set fusing ancient Zonai technology; after wearing it, using Fuse (fusing and building) becomes faster. With all three pieces worn, building actions are completed almost instantly.
获取：三件分别位于地底世界的佐纳依遗迹宝箱，需解开佐纳依机关谜题后才能开启。
How to get: the three pieces are located in Zonai ruin treasure chests in the Depths, which can only be opened after solving Zonai mechanism puzzles.
🔥 火焰攻击 套装加成：炎爆
🔥 Fire Attack · Set bonus: Flame Burst
穿戴后近战攻击附带火焰伤害，可自动点燃敌人。三件齐穿后攻击触发炎爆效果，对周围敌人造成范围火焰伤害。与耐火套装不同，此套装着重进攻。

After wearing it, melee attacks deal bonus fire damage and can automatically set enemies alight. With all three pieces worn, attacks trigger a flame burst effect, dealing area fire damage to surrounding enemies. Unlike the Flamebreaker Set, this set focuses on offense.
获取：三件均在格鲁德火山地区宝箱（包括地底对应区域），需耐火保护才能进入获取。
How to get: all three pieces are in treasure chests in the Gerudo volcano region (including the corresponding Depths region); fireproof protection is needed to enter and obtain them.
⚡ 雷电攻击 套装加成：雷链
⚡ Lightning Attack · Set bonus: Lightning Chain
穿戴后近战攻击附带雷电，命中可传导至附近敌人。三件齐穿触发雷链效果，攻击同时传导至最多三个目标，对群战极为有效。

After wearing it, melee attacks deal bonus lightning, and hits can conduct to nearby enemies. With all three pieces worn, the Lightning Chain effect triggers, conducting attacks to up to three targets at once, extremely effective against groups.
获取：完成卓拉领地「雷电研究」支线任务系列，三个任务分别获得一件。
How to get: complete the 'Lightning Research' side quest series in Zora's Domain; the three quests award one piece each.

Zora ceremonial dress; after wearing it, swimming speed in water increases greatly. With all three pieces worn, the Waterfall Ascent ability unlocks, letting you surf up waterfalls. An essential set for exploring Zora's Domain.

利特族羽毛编织的保暖套装，穿戴后在寒冷地区不受冻伤。三件齐穿顺风滑翔时速度额外加快，是雪山和利特村探索的舒适选择。

A warm set woven from Rito feathers; after wearing it, you won't suffer frostbite in cold regions. With all three pieces worn, gliding speed increases further with a tailwind, making it a comfortable choice for exploring snowy mountains and Rito Village.

The Divine Beast armor (torso) of Gerudo Champion Urbosa, golden Gerudo armor; after wearing it, attacks deal bonus lightning and you are immune to your own lightning strikes, pairing perfectly with Gerudo Desert exploration.

Evil spirit armor from another dimension, twisted and eerie in appearance; after wearing it, attacks have a chance to ignore enemy defense. With all three pieces worn, damage against high-defense targets (such as general knights) increases greatly.

An ancient set forged from rare Zonaite ore, with a resonance effect on Zonai mechanisms that improves their operating efficiency. With all three pieces worn, building actions speed up and consume less energy.

依盖族（加侬多夫手下部队）的制服，穿戴后在野外移动时敌方依盖族不会主动攻击。三件齐穿可进入依盖据点而不被发现，是支线任务神器。

The uniform of the Yiga Clan (Ganondorf's troops); after wearing it, enemy Yiga in the wild won't attack on sight. With all three pieces worn, you can enter Yiga hideouts without being detected, making it a godsend for side quests.

How to get: defeat the camp captains of three large Yiga camps; they drop the head, torso, and leg pieces respectively.
